title: Following the second van to Noise Cancellation Technologies (NCT)

tellings.quote: and it went to um a a company called Noise Cancellation Technology, NCT.

plain: Dan Sherman, a former Air Force sergeant who says the National Security Agency, the US spy agency for communications, trained him to communicate with aliens, tells of an episode in 1991 near an agency training site in Linthicum, Maryland. He says he followed a second van and watched it go to a company called Noise Cancellation Technologies, suggesting a link between his secret programme and a private firm.
